name: Nagato Kokone
source:
An underground idol active mainly in small live houses in Akihabara. 
She belongs to the group Baby☆Macaron. While exuding the full charm of a classic idol, her ambition to succeed is unmatched. 
She distinctly switches between on- and off-stage life, often wearing high-end brand clothes and accessories in her spare time — a departure from her underground idol persona.

[From in-game profile]
